dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You have a cold. You should rest and drink a lot of water.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈhæv ə ˈkoʊld. juː ʃʊd ˈrɛst ənd ˈdrɪŋk ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Should I go to class tomorrow?
dialogue.reading: ʃʊd aɪ ˈɡoʊ tə ˈklæs təˈmɑːroʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, you shouldn't. You should stay in bed for two days.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, juː ˈʃʊdənt. juː ʃʊd ˈsteɪ ɪn ˈbɛd fər ˈtuː ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I work on the weekend?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I don't think so. You shouldn't work this weekend.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. juː ˈʃʊdənt ˈwɜːrk ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Thank you for your advice.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ədˈvaɪs.
